The matrix's reason for listing M8 as a harmless backstop names context.go:193, but that check compares the BUNDLE's pinned revision to the live state and never reads b['policy_revision'], which :146 reads for the first time. Card step 2 requires the final acceptance transaction to re-check revision/epoch, and no id in the 46 (or the 118) pins it. Fixable in scope with a new part-F id; no injection needed.

problems.title: acceptance.go:348 (the between-the-two-reads snapshot equality) is removable with nothing turning red, and removing it lets the accept transaction commit on a moved snapshot

problems.title: the new part-E isolation id states a mechanism that my controls disprove, and its expected value is pinned to an unrelated enum member
problems.detail: W06-01-NEG-ISOLATION-VERIFIER-ONLY-ARTIFACT-REFUSED-AT-CREATION expects [400,0,0] and its evidence text asserts the isolation boundary is enforced by CreateArtifactRequest so that a verifier-only object cannot be created at all. CreateArtifactRequest enumerates VERIFIER_ONLY; the 400 is caused by the request's evidence_kind 'OBSERVATION', which is not a member of $defs.EvidenceKind [OBSERVED, SIMULATED, GENERATED]. I submitted the same body with access_class PROJECT and got the same 400; with a legal evidence_kind the VERIFIER_ONLY creation is refused 403 'restricted reference unavailable' by the router's visibleAs pre-check, and the PROJECT control 403 'current executor role required'. This is the third consecutive round a claim about this face has carried a wrong cause, and it is now inside registered evidence rather than only in prose.
